sections.title: About 1Password
paras: At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Apono is now part of 1Password . Together, we’re shaping the future of identity security for humans, machines, and AI agents. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. We deliver just-in-time, just-enough access governance, unleashing productivity without compromising security. If you’re excited to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals and solve hard problems at scale, come join us and help build a safer, simpler digital future for everyone.

sections.title: What you can expect:
paras:
The annual base salary for this role is between $202,000 USD and $293,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work
bullets: Set direction across the Apono platform, creating alignment across product areas, user experiences, workflows, and integrations.
Own roadmap execution, making priorities clear, surfacing tradeoffs, and connecting delivery to company goals.
Guide release planning and tracking, including dependencies, scope changes, launch readiness, and post-release learning.
Lead, mentor, and support a team of Product Managers as they grow their skills and deliver meaningful customer and business impact.
Coach product teams to identify meaningful customer problems, validate assumptions, and deliver focused minimum viable products (MVPs).
Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Go To Market (GTM), Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Product Marketing.
Engage with customers and prospects to understand access management challenges and turn those insights into product opportunities.

ashby:delinea:75bfae3f-6a55-40df-bff0-49.summary:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

sections.title: Position Summary:
paras:
Sales Engineering at Delinea is organized by the accounts you own, across four segments: Strategic, Enterprise, Commercial, and Federal and Public Sector. The Delinea StrongDM specialist team works across all four. We don't own accounts; we own the technical win for runtime authorization inside them, alongside the segment Account Executives and Sales Engineers who do. The ladder from Sales Engineer to Senior to Principal runs along the same axis: deal, team, company.

As a Senior Sales Engineer on the specialist team, you own the technical win for runtime authorization in the most complex opportunities across every segment, and you multiply the field around you: the demos and assets you build, the segment Sales Engineers you enable, and the patterns you establish outlast any single deal. You bring deep expertise in identity and access management (IAM) and privileged access management (PAM), hands-on fluency in the infrastructure people actually need to reach, and a forward-looking view of how AI agents change who, and what, needs access.

Delinea StrongDM is the runtime authorization layer of the Delinea Platform. It replaces standing access with just-in-time (JIT) access and ephemeral credentials to databases, servers, Kubernetes, and cloud environments, governed by Cedar-based policy that can evaluate individual actions, down to an AI agent's Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls. You show customers how it works alongside the rest of the platform.

To platform engineering leaders, security architects, and CISOs, you are a trusted technical advisor, translating business requirements into measurable outcomes: Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP), faster developer access, governed AI agents, and audit-ready compliance.

Sound interesting? Read on.

What You'll Do
bullets: Serve as the technical lead for runtime authorization in the most complex opportunities across all four segments, focused on Delinea StrongDM and how it combines with the rest of the Delinea Platform.
Partner with segment Account Executives and Sales Engineers to identify, qualify, and accelerate runtime authorization opportunities, adding depth to the account team without adding friction.

Lead technical discovery to find the real problem behind the request, whether standing privileges, credential sprawl, audit gaps, developer friction, or ungoverned AI agents, and connect it to the business outcome the customer needs.
Challenge the customer's current access architecture and the status quo in the account, backed by a design that is demonstrably better.
Deliver compelling demonstrations, technical presentations, and workshops tailored to platform engineers, SREs, security architects, and executives, and handle the unscripted question live.
Own and drive Proofs of Value (PoVs) and technical evaluations from scoping through success criteria to a documented technical win.

Develop solution designs, including architecture diagrams, integration specifications, and deployment plans spanning identity providers, databases, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, SIEM, ITSM and ChatOps tools, and AI agent toolchains.
Respond to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires for runtime authorization, verifying every answer against current product documentation before it reaches the customer.

sections.title:
What You'll Bring

Required
bullets: 5+ years of experience in a pre-sales Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Sales Architecture role, with at least 3 years focused on IAM or PAM and demonstrated ownership of complex evaluations, from scoping to technical win.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Hands-on expertise in IAM and PAM, with the ability to explain the identity threat landscape and the principles of zero trust, least privilege, JIT access, and ZSP, and why they matter to the business.
Strong command of identity protocols and directories, including SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos, and PKI, with hands-on experience in Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping, or Active Directory.

Hands-on experience with, or deep working knowledge of, infrastructure access and PAM platforms such as Teleport, HashiCorp Boundary or Vault, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Okta Privileged Access, or StrongDM.
Strong working knowledge of enterprise infrastructure: Linux and Windows administration, SSH and RDP, common databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server, and networking fundamentals.
Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), including its IAM model, and working familiarity with Kubernetes and containerized environments.
Familiarity with DevOps and automation practices, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code such as Terraform, REST APIs, and scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

sections.title: Nice to Have
bullets: Hands-on experience with Delinea StrongDM or other Delinea products.
Experience securing machine identities, service accounts, secrets, and AI agents, including familiarity with MCP or agentic AI frameworks.
Policy-as-code experience with Cedar, OPA/Rego, or similar.
An established public presence in the identity or DevOps community, such as a technical blog, demo videos, conference or meetup talks, open-source contributions, or an engaged LinkedIn audience.
Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Security+, CKA, Okta, or cloud provider security certifications.
Experience with MEDDICC or similar enterprise sales qualification frameworks.

sections.title: What You'll Get
paras: Apply if you believe your experience and perspective will help us deliver for our customers, even if you don't meet every requirement listed above.

What Distinguishes This Level

Every level is held to the same six core values listed below. As a Senior on a specialist team, Ownership extends past the deals you support to the field's ability to sell runtime authorization without you: the demo environments, the reusable designs, and the segment Sales Engineers you enable. Respect carries extra weight in an overlay role: you make the segment Sales Engineer and Account Executive stronger in front of their customer, raise disagreements with them directly and privately. Nimble means you take on the newest capability first, today that is AI agent access governance, so the rest of the field doesn't have to. Challenging the status quo becomes your default: you question whether the customer's current vault and session-level controls actually remove standing privilege, not just answer questions about ours.
bullets: A seat on the specialist team leading Delinea's runtime authorization and AI agent access motion across every segment.
A collaborative Sales Engineering team across the US and UK/EU that picks up what you build and gives you credit for it.
Investment in your growth, including training, certifications, and conference attendance.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Storage and networking are what turn graphics processing units (GPUs) into a cloud. Customers come to Lambda for compute, then decide whether to stay based on where their data lives and whether the network gets it to the GPUs fast enough to keep them busy.

As a product manager on the Foundational Infrastructure team, you will own a meaningful part of defining where customer data lives on Lambda and how it gets to the GPUs. On storage, the domain covers where weights, checkpoints, and datasets sit, how customers get data in and keep it current, what performance they can count on when loading a model, and how capacity is metered and priced. On networking, it covers moving that data at the throughput training and inference demand, and the tenant isolation and virtual private cloud that enterprises require before they put production on us. It also covers how customers reach Lambda from their own networks, how traffic is balanced in front of serving endpoints, what egress they control, and how bandwidth is shared without one tenant starving another.
You will most likely work across both spaces rather than sit in one of them, following what customers need most at the time, alongside the other product managers on the team.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Find the Real Problem: Get close to customers, deals, escalations, and support on On-Demand GPU Instances and 1-Click Clusters, and work out what is actually blocking them on data and connectivity rather than what they asked for.
Decide What Matters: Rank and sequence the work in front of you across storage and networking, and be honest about what Lambda is not doing this year and why.
Write the Definition: Produce requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria precise enough that engineering builds from them without a translation layer.
Price and Package It: Decide how storage and data transfer are metered, priced, and packaged across Lambda's public and private cloud offerings, and how customers compare the options.
Deliver With Engineering: Work through the build with the storage and networking teams, make the tradeoff calls that come up mid-flight, and keep scope honest against the date.

Land the Launch: Set launch criteria that cover the operational readiness an infrastructure product needs, and get documentation, pricing, sales, and support in place before it goes live rather than after.
Measure and Iterate: Define what success looks like before launch, then go find out whether it happened, using adoption and real workload performance rather than opinion.
Make the Call Stick: Take a position on contested tradeoffs, write it down well enough that people can disagree with it precisely, and keep owning the decision after it is made.

Have real depth in one of the two domains and enough range in the other to make decisions in it, plus the appetite to close that gap quickly.

sections.title: 🚀 Our Story
paras: Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.

Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify), with Blackbird Ventures, WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree and Ecliptic Venture Capital. ashby:perplexity:08f1a218-bdff-4cdd-aefe.summary:
Perplexity is revolutionizing how companies get work done. We are seeking an Associate Product Marketing Manager to join our team and serve as the bridge between how our products actually work and how the world learns to use them. You will develop the deepest product understanding on the team and translate it into webinars and education materials that inspire adoption and drive growth.

If you have a passion for understanding how things work, thrive in taking something complex and making it simple, and want to build a world-class product education engine that turns new users into power users, this role is for you.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Know the product cold. Develop a deeper working knowledge of our products than anyone else in marketing, using every feature the day it ships, building the workflows yourself, and staying close to the teams that built them.

Turn complexity into clarity. Transform complex product capabilities into simple, specific, and accurate explanations, defining not just what we built, but how it works, when to use it, and why it matters.
Teach at scale. Own product webinars end to end, from content and live demos to delivery and follow-up, spanning onboarding series, feature deep-dives, and use-case walkthroughs.

Build the education engine. Create the product education materials our users learn from: how-to guides, demo flows, video walkthroughs, and use-case libraries that make customers materially better at their jobs.

Obsess over the user. Maintain a sharp, real-time view of what users misunderstand and where they get stuck, ensuring our education remains grounded in how people actually use the product rather than how we assume they do.

Measure outcomes, not just outputs. Tie webinars and education content to tangible activation, adoption, and retention, running lightweight experiments to iterate fast on format, content, and delivery.

Get products to launch. Own and coordinate the cross-functional workstreams that take products from built to launch, keeping teams aligned on dependencies, timelines, and the work needed to bring each launch to market.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: 2-3 years of experience in product marketing, customer education, business development, or a related role, ideally within a high-growth technology company, or work that proves the skill regardless of title.
Proven ability to synthesize complex technical concepts into simple, specific, and provable explanations that travel across new users, power users, and admins.
Genuine obsession with product: you explore every setting, test every new feature, and can explain what a product does better than the team that built it.
Sharp teaching and storytelling skills grounded in data, with the ability to summarize how a feature works in a single sentence and demonstrate it live.
High slope: you learn unfamiliar products and domains fast, and your rate of improvement is your standout trait.
Extreme comfort delivering clarity in high-velocity, ambiguous environments.

Perplexity is hiring sellers fast, and every new seller has to learn a fast-moving product line: Enterprise, Comet, Computer and the API. We're looking for a Sales Onboarding Manager to own how new sellers go from their first day to selling on their own. You'll build the program, keep it current, run it, and certify that each seller is ready before they sell independently.

This is a high-ownership, highly visible role on a small Sales Enablement team. You'll partner with the Sales Enablement Lead and work closely with sales leaders, frontline managers, Product, Product Marketing, Solutions and Revenue Operations. Your goal is a robust, relevant, progressive and measurable ramp that gets faster as we scale.

sections.title: About the role
paras: The Sales Onboarding Manager owns the onboarding experience for Enterprise and Commercial Account Executives (AEs) and Business Development Representatives (BDRs), from Day 1 through field certification. You'll design the curriculum, keep it up to date as the product changes, lead the sessions yourself, manage the logistics of placing each cohort into the right sessions, and run the certifications that decide when a new hire is ready.

Company-wide new-hire orientation is owned by a separate onboarding role. Ongoing training for ramped sellers is owned by Sales Enablement. You'll partner with both so new sellers move smoothly from orientation into their sales ramp and then into working independently with ongoing training from Enablement.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Own the sales onboarding program. Co-design and run role-based ramps for BDRs and for Enterprise and Commercial AEs, including learning objectives, milestones and time-to-productivity targets for each stage. Where BDRs and AEs need the same foundations, they learn them together. Where the jobs differ, each gets its own track.

Build the BDR ramp. Teach new BDRs prospecting and outbound: ideal customer profile and persona research, account and territory rules, multi-channel sequences, cold calling, cold email, qualification, and clean handoffs to AEs. Get BDRs productive in the prospecting stack, including Salesforce, Apollo and the dialer.

Build and maintain content. Create and update modules, playbooks, talk tracks, demo guides, knowledge checks and self-paced content. Update materials as products, pricing, positioning and process change, and retire anything out of date.

Facilitate live sessions. Lead engaging, interactive sessions (virtual and in person) on Perplexity's products, sales process, customer personas, discovery, demos, objection handling and tools. Bring in subject-matter experts from Product, Product Marketing, Solutions and top sellers.

Run cohort logistics. Work with Recruiting and sales leaders to track incoming hires, assign each one to the right sessions for their role, segment and start date, and manage calendars, attendance, make-ups and pre-work.
Partner with frontline managers. Give managers visibility into each new hire's progress, flag risks early, and equip managers to reinforce onboarding through coaching and call reviews.

Measure and improve. Track completion, certification pass rates and ramp attainment. For BDRs, also track activity, meetings booked and accepted, and pipeline sourced. For AEs, also track time to first meeting, pipeline and closed business. Use the data and new-hire feedback to improve the program each cohort.
Scale with leverage. Use AI tools, including Perplexity's own products, to build content faster, personalize learning paths and automate repetitive logistics so the program keeps up with hiring.

sections.title: What we're looking for
paras: The best candidates are strong facilitators who also design programs and run operations well. You can command a room, build a curriculum from a blank page, and keep a complicated cohort calendar running smoothly. You hold a high bar for readiness and know how to tell a manager when a seller isn't there yet.

sections.title: Must-haves
bullets: 2–4 years in sales enablement, sales onboarding or sales training, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS or AI company. Experience carrying a quota or managing sellers is a strong plus.
A track record of designing and running a sales onboarding or ramp program end to end, with measurable impact on ramp time or productivity.
Excellent live facilitation, virtual and in person, with sellers at different experience levels, from early-career BDRs to seasoned AEs.
Experience designing and running certifications or skills assessments (such as cold-call, pitch, discovery or demo) using rubrics that sales managers trust.
Strong program management and operational rigor. You can run several overlapping cohorts, schedules and stakeholders without dropping details.
Working knowledge of modern sales methods (such as MEDDICC, Command of the Message or similar), outbound prospecting and the full sales cycle from first touch to close.
Comfort learning technical products quickly and explaining them clearly. You can learn an AI product well enough to teach and demo it.
Fluency with the sales tech stack, such as Salesforce, a conversation-intelligence tool and an LMS or content-management platform.

ashby:plaid:542d46b1-1032-49c8-b96f-806a.summary: We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. ashby:posh:6ae2c805-ba30-4c8d-b6bf-ab7fb.summary:
We are all social creatures, but the dominant “social” companies today have evolved into digital loneliness machines, driving isolation, anxiety, and mental health challenges around the world.

Human connection is lost. Posh is a beacon guiding us back.

Posh enables anyone to build an IRL community based on shared interests, while connecting consumers with the communities of people just like them. Founded by event organizers who were frustrated with the growing loneliness epidemic and the tools available to build their own event brand, we’ve built the ultimate platform for launching, monetizing, and finding IRL communities of people just like you. In just 6 years, Posh has grown to a team of 70, expanded to 10M+ users, secured $70m in venture funding, and facilitated over $400M in transactions.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Posh is hiring a Customer Success Manager to own our SMB segment : exclusive event organizers earning or projected to earn $75K-$130K in annual GMV .

This is a builder role. You’ll manage a large book of business (around 400 accounts), the majority of which you’ll serve through a scaled, one-to-many motion. Your one-to-one time goes to two much smaller groups: organizers who are onboarding and those that look ready to grow. Everyone else is supported by the engine you build: automation, lifecycle playbooks, and live programming.

You’ll be the first dedicated owner of this segment, which means you won’t inherit a playbook; you’ll build it. You'll onboard every new SMB organizer our sales team closes with a single structured onboarding call, then route them into the education webinar series you run, guiding them from contract signature through their first live event. Then you’ll build the systems (segment analysis, growth-signal automations, email and SMS playbooks) that surface the right account at the right moment so your one-to-one time always goes where it drives the most growth.
bullets: Strong revenue growth across newly onboarded accounts
Onboarding conversion and time-to-first-event: contract signed → account created → event live → tickets sold
Adoption of revenue-driving product features in an organizer’s first 30-60 days
Net Revenue Retention across the SMB book of business, including renewals and upsells for SMB organizers
Qualified graduation opportunities surfaced to Account Management as accounts cross into Mid-Market to close renewal and upsell deals

ashby:ramp:3f4509ad-1858-478b-a7fb-bcd79.summary:
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Buying something for a business should not require finance teams to piece together requests, purchase orders, receipts, and invoices across disconnected systems. Ramp is building a procurement experience that helps employees get what they need, gives finance teams control over commitments, and helps businesses pay for what they actually received.

As a Product Manager for Ramp’s Procurement offering, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ramp’s core procurement capabilities, including sourcing, requisition, approval workflows, renewals, purchase orders, receiving, two- and three-way matching, and inventory management. You will work with Engineering, Design, and Data to turn complex purchasing and accounting requirements into products that are easy to start using and reliable as customers grow.

AI creates an opportunity to rethink this work: build agentic buying experiences for employees, automate work for approvers and stakeholders, and businesses make better purchasing decisions. You will decide where automation can take work off a customer’s plate, where a direct workflow is faster, and where a person needs to review or approve an action. Success means customers get value quickly, adopt the product in their everyday work, and spend less time chasing information and correcting errors.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Own the strategy and roadmap for Ramp’s Procurement pod. Make clear choices about which customer problems to solve, how the capabilities fit together, and what to build next.

Build connected workflows across sourcing, requisition, approvals, renewals, purchase orders, receiving, invoice matching, and inventory management. Partner with Bill Pay, Accounting, and platform teams so purchasing records and decisions carry through to payment and customers’ ERP systems.

Spend time with finance teams, procurement leaders, purchasing operators, and employees. Turn observed friction into simpler experiences for first-time customers and powerful workflows for complex organizations.

Build AI-powered experiences that complete useful work, such as finding new vendors, managing a renewal, drafting a request from a contract, or helping resolve a receipt and invoice discrepancy. Prototype with customers and decide what should be automated, suggested, or handled through direct user controls.

Make automation dependable. Partner with Engineering and Data to define quality measures, test realistic customer scenarios, learn from corrections, and provide clear explanations, approval boundaries, audit trails, and recovery when something goes wrong.

Own outcomes beyond launch. Define and improve activation, repeat usage, time to complete purchasing work, and the accuracy of matching and exception resolution. Use data and customer research to choose the next iteration.

Lead execution with engineers and designers, make scope and sequencing tradeoffs, and align partner teams on dependencies. Work with Sales, Implementation, and Customer Experience to turn customer commitments into repeatable product capabilities and support successful adoption.

sections.title: What You Need
bullets: At least three years of product management or equivalent product-building experience, with evidence of owning a product area from customer discovery through launch and measurable adoption.
Strong product judgment and systems thinking. You can simplify complex workflows while preserving the controls and flexibility customers need.

Hands-on AI fluency, demonstrated through products, prototypes, or meaningful projects. You can reason about model quality, latency, cost, and user control, and choose where AI improves the experience.

Technical and analytical fluency, developed through a technical or analytical degree or equivalent practical experience. You can work with engineers on data models and integrations, use data to investigate problems, and build prototypes to test ideas.
Deep customer curiosity and strong design judgment. You can learn unfamiliar purchasing and finance workflows, distinguish recurring needs from one-off requests, and make the product easier to use.
A track record of leading cross-functional teams, setting priorities, making difficult tradeoffs, and delivering outcomes through others.
Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain a product direction, a complex workflow, and the reasoning behind a decision to technical and non-technical audiences.

ashby:simpleclosure:59fe28bf-c22a-47c9-8.summary:
Most companies don’t end in acquisition — they end in closure. Yet shutdown has never been given the same rigor, clarity, or professionalism as the moments that came before it. Nearly 4 million companies shut down every year, creating a massive, overlooked market. SimpleClosure is building the infrastructure to change that.

Having raised over $20M from leading VCs and trusted by more than 7,000 companies to date, we streamline the entire business dissolution process — from legal and tax to operational and administrative — as one coordinated effort instead of a patchwork of disconnected steps. We go a step further, helping companies sell their remaining assets and return the most value to their stakeholders, through our Asset Hub.

sections.title: Company Overview
paras: As the leading platform for company shutdowns, we have something no one else does: a continuous, proprietary flow of companies winding down, and the assets they built along the way. Our buyers span the top AI labs, RL environment providers, vertical and enterprise agent builders, VCs and deal-flow partners, domain marketplaces, and much more. Dissolution is our wedge; the marketplace is a big part of where we’re headed.

Joining our Asset Hub team means helping to define a new category from the ground up, working on complex, high-stakes problems, and building the products and processes that guide founders through one of the most consequential moments in a company’s life.

sections.title: Job Overview
paras: SimpleClosure is seeking a Solutions Engineer, AI Data, to own how AssetHub’s data gets from the companies that built it into the hands of the AI labs that buy it. When companies wind down, we acquire the real assets they built — production codebases, workspaces, and databases. You’ll pull that data from sellers, shape it to each buyer’s exact requirements, deliver it, and work with buyers to implement different feedback or fixes.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing engineering role that could be forward deployed in some instances. You’ll work directly with research and data teams at frontier AI labs and with founders and engineers on the seller side, in a small, dedicated Asset Hub pod alongside product, engineering, BD, and the GM of Asset Hub.
*Candidates MUST be located in the New York City Metro area.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
bullets: Work with sellers and their engineers to extract codebases, workspace exports (Slack, Jira, Notion, Drive), and databases, and ingest them cleanly into our pipeline.
Translate each buyer’s requirements into custom scripts: transformations, filters, formats, and packaging tailored to how they train and evaluate models.
Own technical delivery end to end: delivery specs, secure transfer, documentation, validation, and iteration until the buyer confirms the data is usable.
Build and run evaluation scripts on codebases and workspaces (quality, completeness, size, training and RL signal), and help define how AssetHub scores and prices assets.
Be the technical point of contact for lab data teams: join buyer calls, answer technical questions, scope custom requests, and feed what you learn into product and pricing.
Turn one-off scripts into reusable tooling so every delivery is faster than the last.
Handle sensitive material (codebases, workspace exports, and proprietary datasets) with strong attention to security, privacy, licensing, and PII handling.

sections.title: Desired Skills & Qualifications
bullets: Experience: 2–5 years as a software, data, or ML engineer, ideally in a forward deployed, solutions, or other customer-facing engineering role.
Core engineering: strong Python and SQL; fast, production-quality scripting and data pipelines; comfortable with messy real-world data.
Evals: familiarity with how LLMs are trained and evaluated, including pretraining vs. SFT vs. RL data, evals, agent harnesses, and RL environments.
Ownership: takes delivery from first request to accepted dataset, works scrappily, and thrives in ambiguity.
Communication: credible with a lab researcher in the morning and a seller’s founder in the afternoon.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have - AI-data / evaluation background: experience at an AI data vendor (e.g. Scale, Surge, Snorkel, Mercor, Handshake AI, Turing) or on a lab’s data team, or hands-on work producing training or evaluation data for models. Data licensing or compliance exposure; contributions to public benchmarks or eval frameworks.

ashby:usekernel:bfe58719-6d39-4f54-9664-.summary:
KERNEL is infrastructure for AI agents to use the internet. Agents buy things, run back-office operations and test apps on KERNEL cloud browsers designed for performance, reliability and scale, with identity, observability and payments built in. KERNEL works with any agent harness or model and is trusted by Town, Middesk, Framer, Vercel and more than 20,000 teams. Founded in 2025, we are backed by $22M+ from top investors including Accel and Y Combinator.

Our vision is to be the Internet runtime for agents. Agent traffic now outpaces human traffic. The web needs new rails for access, identity, and trust and we’re building them.

sections.title: The role
paras: We're hiring Product Managers to own core parts of KERNEL's platform. This job description covers several PM roles across the problem spaces below.

Our engineers work with high agency and bring strong product intuition. You’ll set the direction for your area and, with your engineering partners, own whether it succeeds in the market. That means setting priorities, persuading with evidence, and acting as KERNEL's bridge to customers and partners. You'll scope your work, build working prototypes, and write persuasive specs. You'll define problems as often as you solve them.
As KERNEL grows and the technology evolves, you’ll move toward the most important problems and spot new opportunities before anyone asks. Your scope will follow the most impactful work.

sections.title: Where you might focus
paras: You'll likely start in one of the areas below.

sections.title: You will:
bullets: Define your product area's vision, strategy, and outcome metrics. Prioritize, build, and measure impact.
Delight customers by working with them directly, uncovering unmet needs, and identifying opportunities to build broadly useful solutions.
Take what you build to market: shape positioning, pricing, and docs, equip GTM, and own adoption after launch.
Build prototypes yourself with AI, and use them to test ideas with customers and scope work before it reaches engineering.
Drive partnerships with external teams that touch your product area.
Work closely with our engineers, and influence through data and storytelling.

sections.title: What we're looking for
bullets:
You've owned a technical product end to end and you were accountable for its core metric.

• For most people that means 4+ years as a PM, but we care more about ownership than years. Founder or early-employee experience is a plus.
You have excellent judgment and taste. You’ve made high-stakes calls with incomplete data, and you can walk us through how you made them.

You ship. You use AI coding tools to turn an idea into a working prototype, you can read and change a codebase, and engineers trust your scoping.

• Our customers are developers, so strong PM candidates are technical and may even have started their career as a software engineer.
You use AI in your daily work, and are skilled at steering AI to accelerate on the most high-value work.
You have strong communication ability, both written and verbal. You write clearly enough for an engineer, an executive, and an external partner to understand.

You are excited to work on the frontier of the Agentic Internet, where standards are still undefined. You have the curiosity to go deep on how the web works: HTTP, cookies and sessions, OAuth and OpenID Connect, CDNs, and bot management.

Create repeatable playbooks for the renewal lifecycle, including engaging customers about 120 days out in coordination with the BDM, quoting, contracting, procurement and signature, plus a seasonal renewal calendar by sport and region, working with BDMs, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, Deal Desk and RevOps.

sections.title: WHAT YOU’LL NEED
bullets: 5+ years of customer-facing experience in renewals, account management, sales or revenue operations at a SaaS or technology company, including experience leading, mentoring or managing a team.
A track record of owning retention and renewal targets, and of improving them through process, coaching and data.
Strong commercial skills, including pricing, contract terms, negotiation with customers and procurement teams, and price uplift strategy.
The ability to work in a shared-ownership model, partnering with sales colleagues who hold the customer relationship while driving renewal outcomes and timelines.

Comfort with CRM, reporting and forecasting tools (Salesforce or similar), plus excellent communication skills, including confidence presenting to customers and executives and coordinating across time zones and regions.

sections.title: WHY CATAPULT?
paras: Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

The target Total Compensation range for this position is $71,248 to $156,591 per year. This range is inclusive of base salary and a target incentive plan (which may include equity, commission, or other bonus structures).
bullets: We have amazing people. We promise you’ll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.
We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
Our workforce spans more than 32 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.

We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

greenhouse:catonetworks:5038210101.summary:
Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era.

As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents.

Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide.

Cato Networks is seeking an Area Channel Manager to develop and manage an assigned group of Trusted Advisors, generate new sales opportunities, and drive revenue growth across the Eastern Region.

sections.title: Responsibilities
paras: Success will be measured against agreed targets for new deal registrations, partner-sourced pipeline creation, quality and progression, execution and measurable outcomes of joint sales and marketing initiatives, and closed-won ACV from partner-sourced opportunities.
bullets: Manage relationships with an assigned group of Trusted Advisors, developing joint plans to identify opportunities and grow their Cato business.
Engage and enable Trusted Advisors to identify prospective customers and bring new opportunities to Cato Networks.
Collaborate with Regional TSDs and Regional Aggregator Channel Managers to align priorities, coordinate partner engagement, and execute growth initiatives.
Connect partners with the appropriate Cato sales, technical, and marketing resources to support opportunity development.
Drive new deal registrations and build a healthy pipeline of partner-sourced opportunities.
Work with Trusted Advisors and local CAE/RSD teams to qualify opportunities, coordinate next steps, and support progression through the sales cycle.
Maintain visibility into partner activity, pipeline development, and progress toward closed-won annual contract value (ACV) goals.
Develop and execute partner initiatives that produce measurable opportunity and revenue outcomes.

sections.title: Requirements
paras: Cato provides a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits plan. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401(k), stock options, Health Savings/Flexible Spending Accounts, flexible time-off, paid parental leave and disability benefits.
bullets: Experience working with TSDs, Trusted Advisors, and Regional and National Aggregators.
Demonstrated success in channel sales, partner management, or partner business development.
Ability to build productive partner relationships and translate joint plans into measurable sales activity.
Experience generating partner-sourced pipeline and collaborating with sales teams to advance opportunities.
Experience coordinating partner marketing activities, campaigns, or end-customer events.
Strong communication, relationship management, planning, and follow-through skills.
Ability to coordinate across partner organizations and internal sales and marketing teams.
Willingness to travel within the assigned territory for partner meetings and events.

greenhouse:cognite:5034372101.summary: Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. Our Moonshot is bold: unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works.

sections.title: How you’ll demonstrate Ownership
paras: As an AI Solutions Engineer , you will bridge the gap between industrial challenges and AI capabilities. You will lead the rapid prototyping of GenAI-powered solutions, design user-facing interfaces, and orchestrate intelligent agent workflows in real customer contexts. You’ll work closely with customer teams, internal stakeholders, and product/engineering to craft lighthouse solutions that demonstrate what’s possible with ATLAS AI.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: End-to-End Prototyping Build cross-stack prototypes using ATLAS AI, CDF, and open-source AI frameworks to solve real customer challenges.
Agent Workflow Design Design and implement multi-agent workflows that combine LLMs, tool use, and reasoning over industrial data.
Customer-Facing Execution Collaborate directly with technical teams at customer sites to refine use cases and integrate solutions in real environments.
Interactive UI Development Build lightweight but powerful UIs that showcase value to executives and operators alike.
System Integration Orchestrate integration between GenAI components, CDF data models, and existing customer systems using scalable software practices.
Evangelism & Enablement Translate technical solutions into compelling narratives that inspire stakeholders across both internal and external audiences.

sections.title: Must-Have Skills
bullets: 3+ years of experience in software engineering, AI solution architecture, or similar roles.
Proven hands-on experience with GenAI systems (LLMs, embeddings, prompt chaining, etc.).
Experience building LLM-driven or agent-based applications (e.g., LangChain).
Solid full-stack development skills, including:
Frontend: React (or similar frameworks) for building interactive UIs.
Backend: Python (or similar) for data orchestration and API integration.
Ability to work across the stack and own the delivery of functional, user-facing solutions.
Strong communication and storytelling skills for both technical and executive audiences.

sections.title: Why Cognite
paras: You will work at the forefront of Industrial AI, partnering with some of the world's leading industrial organisations to solve problems that actually matter at scale — not hypothetical ones. You'll join a collaborative, fast-moving environment where curiosity and ownership are the norm, not the exception. If you want delivery work you can point to and be proud of, we'd love to hear from you.

greenhouse:cyclicmaterialsinc:4422489009.summary:
Cyclic Materials is building a resilient circular supply chain for rare earth elements and other critical materials. Through our fully integrated proprietary technology platform, we recover rare earths from end-of-life products and transform them into high-purity materials used to produce new permanent magnets. These magnets are critical to the modern economy, underpinning AI, automotive, e-mobility, electronics, semiconductor, energy, defense, and other advanced manufacturing sectors.

Founded in 2021, Cyclic Materials has rapidly become a category leader in rare earth recovery, achieving commercial operations in less than five years. We currently operate facilities in Ontario and Arizona, with further expansion underway in South Carolina. Backed by investment accounts advised by T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc., alongside strategic investors including Microsoft, Amazon, Hitachi…

sections.title: Account Executive Partnership
bullets: Work as the inside-sales partner to the Account Executive, supporting accounts and opportunities across Arizona, California, Nevada, Utah, Colorado, Wyoming, Idaho, Montana, Oregon, and Washington.
Prepare account plans, meeting briefs, follow-up actions, pricing information, and commercial materials for customer and supplier discussions.
Maintain regular communication with accounts between outside-sales visits and ensure commitments, questions, and next steps are completed on time.

sections.title: Pipeline Development
bullets: Qualify inbound leads and conduct proactive outreach by phone and email to prospective suppliers, customers, recyclers, dismantlers, processors, and industrial partners.
Develop opportunities across rare earth materials, permanent magnets, end-of-life products, manufacturing scrap, automotive components, electronics, and industrial recycling streams.
Move qualified opportunities through the sales process by confirming material type, volume, quality, location, commercial terms, and timing.
Schedule meetings and hand off field opportunities to the Account Executive with complete account history and clear objectives.

sections.title: Customer and Supplier Account Management
bullets: Serve as a responsive day-to-day contact for assigned customers and suppliers.
Support account onboarding, documentation, pricing communication, order coordination, and issue resolution.
Build strong working relationships through consistent follow-up and accurate communication.
Identify changes in volume, material mix, service needs, or account activity and share opportunities or risks with the Account Executive.
Support account retention and growth by tracking open items and ensuring customers and suppliers receive timely answers.

sections.title: Feedstock Sourcing and Commercial Support
bullets: Support the sourcing and qualification of end-of-life products, rare earth-containing components, manufacturing scrap, magnet production scrap, and electronic waste.
Collect material specifications, photos, weights, recovery information, shipping details, and supplier requirements for commercial review.
Coordinate sample evaluation and internal feedback with Operations, Technical, Logistics, and Finance teams.
Assist the Account Executive with proposals and supply agreements that support reliable volume, quality, and competitive pricing.

greenhouse:dashlane:8319455.summary:
Dashlane is transforming credential security for the modern enterprise. Built on the Dashlane Secure Cloud and powered by a proprietary AI model, the Dashlane Omnix® platform goes beyond the password vault to protect credentials where the workforce actually uses them—in the browser. Millions of consumers and 25,000 organizations worldwide, including brands such as Michelin, Air France and Forrester, trust Dashlane for industry-leading innovations, patented zero-knowledge security and an unmatched user experience. Learn more at dashlane.com .

Being a Dashlaner means we Drive innovation and Value learning, Strive for excellence in everything we do, and Thrive as one Dashlane team. Dashlaners share ideas openly, hold each other accountable, and celebrate wins together.
We move fast because our customers' security depends on it. If you like solving hard problems, learning out loud, and…

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: As a Customer Success Manager, you will be a pivotal player in transitioning our mid-market customer base from reactive maintenance into a disciplined, proactive retention and expansion engine. Joining an ambitious, high-performing team coming off its strongest year to date, you will take full-lifecycle ownership of accounts—from onboarding through product adoption, renewal, and upsell. You will act as a strategic advisor to our clients, ensuring they achieve maximum value from our core products (particularly the Omnix Platform ) while actively elevating our internal operations through strategic account planning, AI-driven workflows, and process automation. This is a unique opportunity to challenge conventional CS processes, move upmarket, and leave a lasting footprint on how our organization operates. This role is based in our New York City office on a hybrid schedule (in-office Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays).

sections.title: At Dashlane you will:
bullets: Own the complete customer journey for a portfolio of mid-market accounts, guiding clients seamlessly from initial onboarding to long-term partnership.
Lead consultative renewals and drive account expansion, proactively identifying commercial opportunities and protecting overall retention.
Accelerate user adoption and engagement across core products like Omnix, ensuring customers realize ongoing strategic value.
Design and execute tiered account strategies, delivering consultative executive business reviews for high-growth accounts while utilizing automation for scaled touchpoints.
Spearhead operational initiatives and leverage modern AI workflows to streamline portfolio analysis, improve risk detection, and elevate team-wide execution.
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Support to champion the voice of the customer and resolve complex escalations.

sections.title: Requirements:
bullets: 3+ years of Customer Success or Account Management experience within a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment.
Proven experience managing accounts across the full customer lifecycle from onboarding to renewals
Experience using product analytics, health metrics, or CRM platforms to assess account health, forecast risk, and plan account strategy.
Comfortable using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) to streamline daily workflows, draft communications, and synthesize portfolio data.

sections.title: We're Also Looking For:
bullets: Prior experience within Cybersecurity, Identity and Access Management (IAM), or security-focused SaaS platforms.
A "builder" mindset with an innate drive to optimize processes, build playbooks from scratch, and scale operational efficiency.
High learning agility and intellectual curiosity—eager to dive deep into nuanced technical products and complex customer operating models.

greenhouse:easygo:5275964007.summary:
Live streaming is new to many advertisers, and that’s your opportunity. As a Client Partner, you’ll own a named book of agencies and advertisers. You’ll help them understand KICK’s audience, build plans that meet their goals and show them the results that keep them coming back.

What you’ll build with us:
Grow KICK’s US advertising revenue across video, display and native, as well as sponsorships and branded integration campaigns. You’ll look after your accounts from first brief to renewal and find where they should be spending more with KICK.

This is a full-time opportunity based in New York. You’ll work from home, but you won’t be working alone. You’ll be out in the market with agencies and advertisers, working closely with our US commercial team and connected to our Australian and Serbian teams as we build KICK’s US presence together.

sections.title: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge?
paras:
Who is Easygo and KICK?
Easygo is a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands, including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. These brands have a fierce global following, but our crew is employed directly by Easygo, and that’s where the real fun happens.

KICK is our live streaming platform, built to put creators and their communities first. It gives content creators 95% of their streaming income and has redefined what a live streaming platform can be. KICK started as a disruptor challenging the status quo. Since launching in 2022, it has grown to more than 100 million accounts, and 81.7% of its audience is aged 18 to 34. Creators stream on KICK across gaming, talk shows, podcasts, IRL, sport and events.

We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast, and who are ready to Unify, Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact, and that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else.

sections.title: The impact you’ll make:
bullets: Own and grow the revenue for your named book of agencies and advertisers
Own your pipeline and forecast, commit to a number and stand behind it
Shape the strategy, solution and pitch for every brief in your book
Negotiate rates and terms, and protect pricing
Build account plans that grow spend through renewals, cross-sell and programmatic
Bring sponsorships and creator-led campaigns to your clients, working with our Creator Partnerships team

sections.title: Your track record:
bullets: 5 to 9 years in digital sales, ideally selling media or advertising at a US platform or publisher
A record of holding a quota on a named book and growing it year on year
Experience selling through media agencies and direct to advertisers
Working knowledge of programmatic (PMPs, programmatic guaranteed, and DSP and SSP mechanics)
Familiarity with CRM and order management systems (Boostr is a plus)
Confidence presenting to senior stakeholders, and pushing back with a reason and an alternative when something isn’t possible

sections.title: Bonus points if you also have:
bullets: Experience with creator networks, live streaming, entertainment or gaming platforms
Professional Spanish or Portuguese, for US Hispanic and Latin American campaigns
Relationships with planning and investment teams at US agencies
Experience selling sponsorships, branded content or creator-led campaigns alongside media
Knowledge of campaign measurement, like brand lift studies and IAS, DoubleVerify or Nielsen

greenhouse:eplusinc:4432097009.summary:
Hybrid Remote Opportunity - Candidates MUST BE geographically located within an hour commute to Albany OR Syracuse, New York.

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you’ll be focusing on strategic planning, road mapping, and design of service-based technology solutions that measurably improve business outcomes. The role bridges business stakeholders and technical teams, translating client needs into secure, scalable, and cost-effective architectures. You will serve as a technical lead supporting the ePlus regional sales team to find and/or create opportunities within our customer base. You will have the opportunity to work with our experienced architects, engineers, and consultants, and under your guidance - bring together the right team to understand our customers' needs and craft the optimal solution.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: The base salary range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $120,000 and $170,000 annually; however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including commissions and discretionary bonuses, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and personal leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. ePlus Benefits highlights can be viewed here .

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

At ePlus, we believe technology is a people business. Our team is passionate, skilled, and driven to deliver solutions that make a real difference. Join us and be part of a culture that values collaboration, innovation, and extraordinary results.
Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging
bullets: Act as the technical lead and trusted advisor to ePlus account teams and customer stakeholders on your focus area
Run discovery to capture business and technical requirements, then recommend the ePlus solution (hardware, software, and services)
Design and document solution architecture, detailed configurations, and bills of materials (BOMs)
Build and deliver customer-facing presentations, proposals, and recommended-solution reviews
Lead technical scoping sessions for Statements of Work on simple and complex installation, configuration and day-2/managed deals
Build and maintain relationships with ePlus internal delivery engineers to act as a liaison between customer, sales, and delivery teams.
Author the technical sections of RFP / RFI / RFQ responses
Partner with AEs on account and opportunity planning — qualification, technical strategy, and competitive positioning

greenhouse:esri:5262794007.summary:
GIS Solution Engineers on our Civilian Sciences team are highly technical, trusted advisors to customers across USDA, DOI, DOT, and the tribal community. They inspire customers supporting mission-critical work pushing GIS to new heights. Not only do they create innovative solutions, they talk about solutions in ways that get others excited about the power of GIS technology.

Solution Engineers collaborate across Esri and advise customers on their most complex business challenges. Leveraging problem-solving and critical listening skills, they demonstrate the value of GIS finding unique patterns, trends, and understanding. Each day poses new challenges and new discoveries with ArcGIS. At Esri, your ideas and curiosity are celebrated, and a growth mindset isn’t just encouraged – it’s the standard.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Build relationships. Present, demonstrate, and support selling Esri software and solutions as part of the account team. Support your team as you help plan and execute sales strategies.

Be an expert. Become a subject matter expert of Civilian Sciences as well as a technical expert of ArcGIS. Speak confidently with customers about Esri technologies and thoroughly communicate the Esri message. Be a visionary for your customers anticipating their needs and the technology trends that may impact them.

Solve problems . Proactively craft and propose solutions that clarify how GIS brings business value to our customers by addressing the critical challenges they face. Define and deliver strategies to customers that align Esri technology with their business.

Tell our story. Present technical demonstrations of proposed solutions to customers. Successfully design presentations for technical and non-technical customers. Provide best practices related to the use, deployment, and administration of Esri technology. Present at conferences and trade shows.

sections.title: Requirements
bullets: 2+ years of experience with Esri technology creating maps, performing spatial analysis, and configuring web applications
1+ years of experience in Civilian Sciences
Understanding of ArcGIS from an IT context (such as hardware, storage, security, networking, web services, virtualization, cloud computing)
Experience in technical consulting and conceptual solution design as well as an understanding of sales and business development processes
Experience with geodatabases and underlying DBMS technology
Knowledge of cloud computing concepts and environments (Microsoft Azure or AWS)
Remarkable presentation, interpersonal, and listening skills
Ability to travel domestically or internationally 25-50%

sections.title: Recommended Qualifications
paras: Questions about our interview process? We have answers .
bullets: Ability to troubleshoot client issues related to Esri application deployment and system architecture
Experience integrating software solutions with other business systems including data warehousing, BI, CRM, ERP, and analytics platforms
Experience incorporating real-time information streams with existing GIS data and IT infrastructure
Basic understanding of artificial intelligence/machine learning concepts
Programming and scripting experience with languages such as Python and JavaScript
Master’s degree in geography, data science, computer science, or a related field

sections.title: Total Rewards
paras: Esri’s competitive total rewards strategy includes industry-leading health and welfare benefits: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance for employees (and their families), 401(k) and profit-sharing programs, minimum accrual of 80 hours of vacation leave, twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year, and opportunities for personal and professional growth. Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

greenhouse:eucalyptus:4709366005.summary:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

sections.title: About the role (What you'll be doing)
paras: We’re looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Insights. You’ll build the personalised health layer that turns each patient’s data into visible progress, progress into insight, and insight into the next action; helping more of our patients get healthier, for life.

Weight-loss medications are the biggest shift in metabolic health care this generation has seen. But the support around the medication dictates whether our patients lose the weight in a healthy manner and are able to keep the weight off. Our high-touch, proactive support model is the key reason why Juniper has become a market leader, and Insights is the core engine that powers it: getting our patients the right insight, the right intervention, at exactly the right moment. We believe we're still early on what's possible here.

As a Lead Product Manager, you'll set the vision and strategy for Insights across Juniper and our brands, and you'll be accountable for the engagement, retention and patient-outcome metrics that flow from it. This includes shaping the features that help us better understand our patients — including weight tracking, body composition tracking, progress photos, nutrition tracking, sleep and more. You'll work hand-in-hand with our Chief Commercial Officer, Principal Product Manager, clinical leadership, design, data science and engineering to shape and deliver ambitious bets.

sections.title: Key responsibilities
bullets: Lead The Vision & Roadmap: Working with the Chief Commercial Officer & Principal Product Manager, shape the vision for Insights that power our patient’s proactive care. Set the direction and define the bets we make

Execute Quickly, Deliver Globally: Design experiences that make a patient feel their progress and drive engagement, habit formation and long-term retention. Take products from idea to impact and ship them to patients across every market Juniper and future brands operate in. You'll own delivery end-to-end and stay close to the craft

Drive Patient Outcomes, Engagement & Retention: Own your key engagement and retention metrics, connecting product decisions to real health outcomes and commercial impact. You’ll use data and patient insight to understand what's working and what needs to change.
Raise Bar On Craft: Partner closely with design and clinicians to set a high standard for quality, so every insight feels intuitive, trustworthy and distinctly Juniper.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align clinicians, data, design and engineering, and partner with senior stakeholders to unblock execution and deliver cohesive end-to-end outcomes.

sections.title: About you
paras: AI has changed what it means to be a Product Manager, so we are very open to what background you come from. You’ve likely built your experience over 5+ years across:
Ultimately, we’re looking for a high-agency individual that spikes on the following qualities:
bullets: Product Management, with ownership of consumer-facing, high-engagement product domains
Professional Services (like top-tier management consultancies, legal firms)
Other roles within a high-growth startup, or founded your own startup

First-principles problem solver — You are able to break ambiguous problems down, build a clear and focussed strategy around it, and able to take something from idea to impact while applying clear judgement on tradeoffs along the way

Commercial & analytical rigour — You are laser-focused on delivering outcomes. You design for outcomes you can measure, interpret both quantitative and qualitative signal, and won't mistake motion for progress

Product sense — You have a real instinct and empathy for what makes a person feel something. You can tell the difference between a feature that's “works” and one that lands, and you have a strong intuition for what makes products feel delightful, trustworthy and easy to use
Ownership and comfort with ambiguity — you're energised by ambiguous, high-impact, undefined problems, and you've got a track record of navigating and leading through ambiguity

Influence without authority — You have a track record of building credibility and follower-ship amongst teams and stakeholders, built off the consistency and quality of your judgement, storytelling ability, and long-term relationship building

sections.title: Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:
bullets: What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.
Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.
Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.
Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.
Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

Pulumi is the cloud infrastructure platform engineers love and enterprises trust. We help teams build, secure, and operate modern cloud applications using real programming languages, backed by an open-source foundation and a powerful SaaS platform. Industry leaders like Snowflake, NVIDIA and Supabase rely on Pulumi to turn cloud infrastructure into a competitive advantage.

Pulumi enables developers and infrastructure engineers to unlock the full power of cloud services with secure, repeatable, production-grade infrastructure across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Datadog, GitHub, and more. As an AI-first organization, we're a leader in the AI Infrastructure space and have our own autonomous infrastructure engineering agent that brings AI-driven operations directly into the cloud engineering workflow.

sections.title: Who We Are
paras: Pulumi is headquartered in Seattle, WA, with a globally distributed team. This is a remote role open to candidates across the U.S., with a preference for those based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Pulumi Cloud holds the state of record for our customers' infrastructure, brokers the credentials and configuration every deployment depends on, decides who and what is allowed to change which resources, records what actually happened, and exposes all of it through APIs that humans and agents build on.

We’re in the middle of a wave of change, with agents playing an increasing role in infrastructure management. Pulumi plays a critical role in helping human engineers achieve their goals, and we’re looking for a thought leader to evolve both our human and agent experiences with our platform.
We're hiring a Senior or Principal Product Manager to own end to end experiences that are agent-ready and human-friendly across:
bullets: Pulumi ESC — environments, secrets, and configuration, including service-backed config
Managed state — the durable system of record for infrastructure, including state reconciliation flows
Registry and Components — how teams package, share, and consume reusable infrastructure
Authorization, RBAC, and auditing — the trust boundary and the record of what crossed it
User experiences — our cloud console, public API and OpenAPI spec, the Pulumi Service Provider, webhooks and notifications, and version control integrations

sections.title: In This Role You Will:
bullets: Own the roadmap for Pulumi Cloud's platform services, partnering with engineering leadership to sequence long-term architectural bets against near-term customer pull.

Define what agent-ready means for a control plane — what an autonomous system needs to safely read config, obtain credentials it never sees, scope its own blast radius, and leave behind an audit trail a security team will accept. Nobody has a settled answer here. You'd be writing it.

Drive the ESC roadmap: how configuration and secrets flow from source systems to every consumer, what atomicity and consistency guarantees we make, and how ESC becomes the default rather than an add-on.

Own the trust boundary. Permissions models, RBAC granularity, and audit are where enterprise deals are won and lost, and where the requirements are least forgiving. Treat them as product, not compliance overhead.
Shape the Registry and Components ecosystem — how teams find, publish, version, and trust reusable infrastructure, and what changes when the consumer is an agent rather than a person.

Treat the API as a first-class product. Our OpenAPI surface, the Pulumi Service Provider, webhooks, and VCS integrations are how platform teams and agents extend Pulumi; their ergonomics deserve the same care as any UI.

Balance the enterprise customers who need governance, isolation, and provable controls against the individual developers who made Pulumi worth adopting in the first place — without quietly making the product worse for either.
Instrument what you ship, define the metrics that matter, and feed usage evidence straight back into roadmap decisions.

sections.title: We’re Looking For Someone With:
bullets: 5+ years in product management, engineering, or technical program management, with real time on platform, API, or infrastructure products.
Taste in API and platform design — you have opinions about resource modeling, versioning, backward compatibility, error semantics, and what separates an API people build on from one they tolerate.

Comfort in the security and identity domain: secrets handling, permissions models, tenancy, and audit. You don't need to have been a security PM, but you should find these problems interesting rather than tedious.
Strong technical instincts and the ability to hold your own with senior engineers on architectural tradeoffs — consistency guarantees, failure modes, migration paths.
A track record of ramping fast in unfamiliar technical domains and forming real opinions, not just synthesizing other people's.
Demonstrated ability to ship high-quality products in ambiguous, complex problem spaces.
Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Support in a product-led growth environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication. We work asynchronously and in writing; clear thinking on the page is the job.
